title: Why Most Gen Zers Are Getting Promotions Faster Than You
script: Gen Z keeps getting promoted before you — and it's not a coincidence. They learned a promotion strategy nobody taught older generations. It's simple: visibility plus results equals advancement. Most people do the work and assume their manager notices. Gen Z does the work and tells their manager what they did. They send weekly updates. They name what they want out loud. They ask for feedback quarterly instead of waiting for annual reviews. That's not annoying. That's a system. And it works. Stop competing with Gen Z. Learn from them.
